notice: Independent fan game. Peak versions, OVR and attributes are fictional game-balance estimates, not official historical ratings. Chemistry is generated by checking every possible pair among the 50 cards for overlapping first-team club and senior international timelines (month-level). Career breaks are represented as separate windows. Link strength is a game-design bonus, not a measured partnership statistic. No official affiliation.
